samplingInterval.description: The sampling interval, in seconds, of the upstream video quality data.

startTime.description: The date and time when this video session started.

endTime.description: The date and time when this video session ended.

packetLoss.description: The percentage of video packet loss, in float between 0.0 and 100.0, during each sampling interval.

latency.description: The average latency, in milliseconds, during each sampling interval.

resolutionHeight.description: The pixel height of the outgoing video.

frameRate.description: The frames per second of the outgoing video.

mediaBitRate.description: The bit rate of the outgoing video.

transportType.description: The network protocol used for video transmission.
